The Chinese characters for Adeline

As a transliteration, Adeline is usually written 阿德琳 (Ā dé lín). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

阿
Ā
a prefix, hill
德
dé
virtue, morality
琳
lín
beautiful jade

Origin and meaning

Adeline comes from French and means “noble”.

About the name Adeline

A French name meaning 'noble' that has been revived in the 21st century.

As a gift or a tattoo

People often order Adeline as a framed gift or as a tattoo — the meaning, “noble”, is part of the appeal.
